t: The Milwaukee Shockwave 1/4" Hex Magnetic Bit Holder 75mm is an essential accessory for impact drivers, designed for secure bit retention during demanding tasks. Manufactured from custom-engineered steel with optimised heat treatment, it offers maximum strength and flexibility. An optimised Shockzone absorbs significant torque, providing increased resistance to shock from impact driving. Ideal for electricians, plumbers, and general builders working on site or in workshops, ensuring reliable performance. The strong magnetic, screw-engaging tip ensures secure fastener retention, while the 1/4″ hex reception suits high-torque and impact applications.
b: Strong Magnetic Tip & Secure Fastener Retention
